name: devflowforge
description: 77 portable engineering and design skills for AI coding assistants: product discovery, UI/UX, architecture, implementation, testing, security and safe delivery.

interface.longDescription: A cross-stack toolkit of 77 self-contained skills for product discovery, UI/UX and design systems, mobile and web engineering, data, AI, security, testing and reliable releases. Guides competent AI coding assistants; skills do not themselves run commands, produce Figma designs or grant repository permissions.
defaultPrompt: Use DevFlowForge to research the users and design a new accessible SaaS dashboard with wireframes, design tokens and an implementation plan.
Audit this repository across architecture, security, product UX, performance and test coverage. Select only relevant skills and cite evidence.
Implement this feature safely: inspect the repository, define acceptance scenarios, review design, test, submit a PR and report anything unverified.
